headline: Thursday in Branson: Crisp Fall Air & Live Entertainment
lede: Thursday, October 29 offers highs in the upper 70s with mostly sunny skies and light winds — perfect conditions for first-timers to enjoy outdoor shows, lake views, and the vibrant energy of Branson without the summer heat.

featured.title: Evening Live Shows
featured.why: World-class entertainment is the heartbeat of Branson. Catch a country, tribute, or magic show — many with same-day tickets available. The Landing fountain shows add free family fun.

plan.title: Lake Morning
plan.detail: Enjoy coffee with Table Rock or Taneycomo views. Mild fall mornings are ideal for a relaxed start and planning your day.

plan.title: Explore & Shop
plan.detail: Visit Branson Landing for waterfront strolling, fountain shows, and local shops. Consider a short drive to the Strip for classic Branson sights.

plan.title: Prime Time Entertainment
plan.detail: Evening is showtime in Branson. Check box office for tonight's lineup — many theaters offer flexible same-day options.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: High-energy country music and comedy in a comfortable venue. A Branson staple for families and music lovers.

indoor.name: Legends in Concert
indoor.detail: Tribute performances featuring iconic musicians in a state-of-the-art theater. Climate-controlled and engaging for all ages.

indoor.name: White River Fish House
indoor.detail: Lakeside dining with fresh seafood and American classics. Great for dinner before or after a show.
